newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Curfew imposed after Nigerian headless body riot.
newsitem.headline: Curfew imposed after Nigerian headless body riot.

text.p: A curfew was imposed in the eastern Nigerian city of Owerri on Wednesday after rioting sparked by the exhumation of a boy's headless corpse.
"Movement of persons between between six p.m. and six a.m. will be restricted," national radio said.
A hotel and over a dozen houses were destroyed on Tuesday by a mob apparently angered by an upsurge in ritual murders in the area.
A headless corpse, along with parts of other human bodies in shallow graves, was recovered from the grounds of the hotel after a man was arrested on Friday with a human head.
The Champion newspaper said a mob burned down the hotel before turning its attention to buildings belonging to local chiefs linked to the hotel's owner.

Police named the dead boy as 11-year-old Ikechukwu Okonoko. He had been hawking groundnuts on the street when he was abducted. His suspected killer, Innocent Ekeanyanwu, died in police custody at the weekend and the Champion quoted police as saying Ekeanyanwu died in his sleep.
Traditional medicine and witchcraft in a number of West African cultures has made use of human body parts.
